quests.instruction: Show me the body part we use to catch a big bouncy ball!
quests.question: Hands
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wave these to say hello.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Hands help you hold, clap, and catch things!
quests.funFact: Your hands can feel if something is soft, rough, hot, or cold.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part you protect from sunburn with sunscreen?
quests.question: Skin
quests.hint: Sunscreen protects this part from the sun.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Skin covers your whole body and helps you feel hot, cold, soft, and rough!
quests.funFact: Your skin makes new cells all the time, all by itself.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that tightens up when you stand on your tiptoes?
quests.question: Calves
quests.hint: They are between your knee and your ankle.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Calves are the back of your lower leg, between your knee and your ankle!
quests.funFact: Calves are the back part of your leg, below your knee.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that feels flat and soft, right in the middle of your hand?
quests.question: Palms
quests.hint: You rub these together to feel warm.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Palms are the flat, soft inside part of your hands!
quests.funFact: Rubbing your palms together quickly can make them feel warm.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that touches the ground first when you walk?
quests.question: Heels
quests.hint: They are below your ankles, at the back.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Heels are the round back part of your feet that touch the ground first!
quests.funFact: Heels touch the ground first with almost every step you take.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we pat gently after a big, yummy dinner?
quests.question: Tummy
quests.hint: It is below your chest, above your legs.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Tummy is the middle of your body that helps digest the food you eat!
quests.funFact: Your tummy helps break down the food you eat into tiny pieces.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part we use to breathe in fresh air!
quests.question: Nose
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It is found between your eyes and your mouth.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Nose helps you smell and breathe in fresh air!
quests.funFact: Breathing through your nose warms the air before it reaches your lungs.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part found between your foot and your leg!
quests.question: Ankles
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are found where your foot meets your leg!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Ankles connect your feet to your legs and help you balance!
quests.funFact: Your ankles help you balance every time you stand on one foot!

quests.instruction: Show me the body part we brush every morning and every night!
quests.question: Teeth
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You use these to bite and chew your food.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Teeth help you bite and chew your food!
quests.funFact: Your teeth are the hardest part of your whole body.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part we use to stand tall and jump high!
quests.question: Feet
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You have two, and you stand on them.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Feet help you stand, walk, and run!
quests.funFact: Your feet help you balance so you do not fall over.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part you lie down on to look up at the clouds!
quests.question: Back
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is the part of you facing away from a mirror!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Back is the part behind you that helps you stand up straight!
quests.funFact: Your back has a strong row of bones running down the middle called your backbone.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part we open wide to sing a happy song!
quests.question: Mouth
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It smiles when you are happy.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Mouth helps you eat, talk, and smile!
quests.funFact: You use dozens of little muscles just to smile with your mouth.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part we blink to keep clean and safe!
quests.question: Eyes
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are found above your nose.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Eyes help you see everything around you, like colors and shapes!
quests.funFact: You blink your eyes thousands of times every single day.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part found halfway between your hip and your ankle!
quests.question: Knees
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are the bendy part in the middle of your leg!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Knees are the bendy joints in the middle of your legs!
quests.funFact: Your knees are the biggest, strongest joints in your whole body!

quests.instruction: Point to the body part that gets covered by a warm winter hat!
quests.question: Forehead
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is the flat part above your eyebrows!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Forehead is the flat part of your face above your eyebrows!
quests.funFact: Your forehead can wrinkle up when you look surprised or confused.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part you scrunch down low when you feel grumpy!
quests.question: Eyebrows
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have two, right above your eyes!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Eyebrows sit above your eyes and help keep sweat and rain out of them!
quests.funFact: Your eyebrows help keep sweat and rain out of your eyes!

quests.instruction: Point to the body part that catches tiny bits of dust before they reach your eyes!
quests.question: Eyelashes
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They flutter every time you blink!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Eyelashes grow along your eyelids and help keep dust out of your eyes!
quests.funFact: Eyelashes work like tiny fans, sweeping away dust from your eyes!

quests.instruction: Show me the body part you count when you play a counting game with your feet!
quests.question: Toes
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You use these to help you balance.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Toes help you balance and push off the ground when you walk!
quests.funFact: Your big toe helps you balance more than any other toe.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that is the biggest, strongest part of your whole leg!
quests.question: Thighs
quests.hint: Hint: They have some of the strongest muscles in your body.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Thighs are the top part of your leg, between your hip and your knee!
quests.funFact: Thighs are the part of your leg above your knees.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part found between your chest and your hips!
quests.question: Waist
quests.hint: Hint: You spin a hula hoop around it.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Waist is the middle part of your body, between your chest and your hips!
quests.funFact: Your waist is where the top and bottom of your body meet.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part found below your waist, above your thighs!
quests.question: Hips
quests.hint: Hint: You put your hands on these like a superhero.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Hips are where your legs connect to your body, and help your legs swing!
quests.funFact: You use your hips every time you take a big dance step.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part we trim carefully to keep our fingertips short and tidy!
quests.question: Fingernails
quests.hint: Hint: They help protect the tips of your fingers.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Fingernails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each finger and protects it!
quests.funFact: It takes about six months to grow one fingernail from base to tip.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part we trim carefully to keep our toes short and tidy!
quests.question: Toenails
quests.hint: Hint: They help protect the tips of your toes.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Toenails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each toe and protects it!
quests.funFact: Keeping toenails trimmed helps your shoes feel comfortable.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that opens wide when you yawn!
quests.question: Jaw
quests.hint: Hint: It opens wide when you yawn.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Jaw moves up and down to help you chew and talk!
quests.funFact: Only your jawbone can move; the rest of your skull stays still.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part found between your hand and your elbow!
quests.question: Wrists
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are found where your hand meets your arm!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Wrists connect your hands to your arms and let your hands turn and wave!
quests.funFact: Each of your wrists has eight tiny bones that help it bend!

quests.instruction: Point to the body part you hold up high to say 'great job' without saying a word!
quests.question: Thumbs
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You point these up to say 'great job!'
quests.explanation: Super! Your Thumbs help your hand grip things and can touch each of your other fingers!
quests.funFact: Your thumbs help your hands grip things tightly, like a cup or a pencil!

quests.instruction: Tap the body part found on the underside of your foot, inside your shoe!
quests.question: Soles
quests.hint: Hint: They can feel very ticklish.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Soles are the bottom of your feet that touch the ground!
quests.funFact: Walking barefoot on grass lets your soles feel every little tickle.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part that has a tiny dip in some people, called a dimple!
quests.question: Chin
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is at the very bottom of your face!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Chin is the part at the very bottom of your face, below your mouth!
quests.funFact: Humans are the only animals with a pointy chin like this!

quests.instruction: Point to the body part you pat gently when you feel proud of yourself!
quests.question: Chest
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You can feel your heart beating right here!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Chest is the front of your upper body, where your heart and lungs are!
quests.funFact: Your chest holds two very important helpers: your heart and your lungs!

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that helps you rise up onto your tiptoes!
quests.question: Calves
quests.hint: Hint: They tighten when you stand on tiptoes.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Calves are the back of your lower leg, between your knee and your ankle!
quests.funFact: Strong calves help you jump higher and run faster.
